commercial.p1.modal.desc: This is a confidential, next-generation Multiplayer MMORPG currently in development. It utilizes the Unreal Engine for the client experience and the high-performance Odin framework for all authoritative server-side game logic.
commercial.p1.modal.contribs: • check_circleUnder Non-Disclosure Agreement.
commercial.p2.modal.desc: An Unreal/C++ Pirate RPG focused on open-world exploration, ship battles, and seamless boarding, all supported by a comprehensive quest system and advanced enemy AI.
commercial.p2.modal.contribs:
• check_circleCoded Quest, Dialog, and Boarding Logic systems.
  • check_circleSet up the Gameplay Ability System (GAS) and contributed to enemy AI implementation.
  • check_circleDeveloped design-specific tools and performed extensive back-end infrastructure work.
commercial.p3.modal.desc: Yaguareté: The Game is a third-person survival adventure set in the dynamic, living world of the Brazilian Pantanal, where you control a jaguar hunting, surviving, and adapting to constant natural and human threats.
commercial.p3.modal.contribs:
• check_circleImplemented all base code, including the foundational Hunt Mechanic and core movement/swimming logic.
  • check_circleDeveloped the Quick Time Event (QTE) system and numerous interactable objects throughout the environment.
commercial.p4.modal.desc: This is a confidential multiplayer 3D card game developed in Unreal Engine, focusing on core mechanics and scalable architecture.
commercial.p4.modal.contribs:
• check_circleArchitected the client framework for reliable multiplayer gameplay.
  • check_circleImplemented core card game logic, state management, and UI integration.
personal.p1.modal.desc: Horror Prototype is a solo-developed first-person psychological horror experience built in the Unity engine. The game traps the player in a non-Euclidean home, leveraging atmospheric tension and complex systems for an intense single-player experience.
personal.p1.modal.contribs: • check_circleSolo developed all systems, design, and atmosphere.
personal.p2.modal.desc: BitSouls is a solo-developed 2D Action-RPG built in Godot engine, heavily inspired by the Souls-like genre, featuring challenging combat and a distinct pixel-art aesthetic.
personal.p2.modal.contribs:
• check_circleDeveloped core combat system, including hit detection, attack states, and stamina management.
  • check_circleImplemented enemy AI behaviors, projectile logic, and level-up/inventory systems.
  • check_circleCreated all UI/HUD elements and handled overall game structure and asset integration.
personal.p3.modal.desc: Maskborne is a cooperative, two-player horror puzzle game built solo using Unreal Engine 5. It serves as a proof-of-concept, demonstrating seamless networking and Steam API integration.
personal.p3.modal.contribs:
• check_circleDeveloped all multiplayer systems, including Steam API connectivity and session management.
  • check_circleImplemented core cooperative horror and puzzle mechanics.
  • check_circleArchitected the foundational structure within Unreal Engine 5.
